notes.title: New Patch for the Launch Error!
notes.content:
Hi. Some people reported that game crashes at launch. I have completely changed Engine version and tested. Hope it will work all of you people. Enjoy!

Don't hesitate to write if there are issues.

notes.title: Driving Experience Patch
notes.content: I have made improvements on car. It is way more eralistic experience now for you to drive. There will be no sliding like you are on ice. Enjoy! (There is break light also).
